about.text: A soft, washed-rind cow's cheese related to Maroilles, made in the Thiérache (Avesnois) in the Nord and Aisne. Fresh curd is kneaded with tarragon, pepper and sometimes cloves, then rests two or three months in a cellar; the rind is often washed with salted water and turns orange.

sources.text: The method, ripening, names and origin, from these articles.
